<style>
/* ==========================================================================
   Harish Ramu — Supply Chain Planning Analyst
   Design concept: "Planning Horizon Ledger"
   Field-logistics vernacular — kraft carton stock, olive field-ops ink,
   red exception flags. The page spine is the plan line; demand-side and
   supply-side work hangs off either edge of it.
   ========================================================================== */

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1. Tokens
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
:root{
  /* Surfaces — mid-tone kraft stock, not cream */
  --kraft:      #E2D7C1;
  --kraft-deep: #D4C7AC;
  --card:       #F3EEE2;
  --card-edge:  #C6B99C;

  /* Ink */
  --ink:        #1E1C17;
  --ink-soft:   #3D392F;
  --mute:       #565141;   /* audited AA on kraft, deep kraft & card */

  /* Field-ops olive — primary accent */
  --olive:      #3C4726;
  --olive-mid:  #55643A;
  --olive-tint: #E9E4CF;

  /* Exception flag — used sparingly, never as decoration */
  --flag:       #9E3117;
  --flag-tint:  #F2E2DB;

  /* Type */
  --display: "Darker Grotesque", "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --body:    "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --data:    "Overpass Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace;

  /* Scale */
  --shell: 1240px;
  --gut: 28px;
  --r-sm: 3px;
  --r-md: 8px;
  --r-lg: 14px;

  --dock-h: 74px;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   2. Reset & base
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
*,*::before,*::after{ box-sizing:border-box; }
html{ -webkit-text-size-adjust:100%; scroll-behavior:smooth; scroll-padding-top:40px; }
body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--kraft);
  color:var(--ink);
  font-family:var(--body);
  font-size:17px;
  line-height:1.62;
  font-weight:400;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overflow-x:hidden;
  padding-bottom:calc(var(--dock-h) + 18px);
}
img{ max-width:100%; height:auto; display:block; }
figure{ margin:0; }
a{ color:inherit; }
ul{ margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; }
h1,h2,h3,h4{ margin:0; font-family:var(--display); font-weight:800; line-height:1.02; letter-spacing:-.005em; }
p{ margin:0; }
button{ font:inherit; color:inherit; }

:focus-visible{
  outline:3px solid var(--flag);
  outline-offset:3px;
  border-radius:2px;
}

.shell{ width:100%; max-width:var(--shell); margin-inline:auto; padding-inline:var(--gut); }

/* Screen-reader only */
.sr{
  position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; padding:0; margin:-1px;
  overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0 0 0 0); white-space:nowrap; border:0;
}
.skip{
  position:absolute; left:16px; top:-60px; z-index:200;
  background:var(--ink); color:var(--kraft);
  padding:10px 18px; border-radius:var(--r-md); font-weight:600;
  transition:top .18s ease;
}
.skip:focus{ top:16px; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   3. Shared type pieces
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.tag{
  font-family:var(--data);
  font-size:12px;
  letter-spacing:.06em;
  color:var(--mute);
  font-weight:600;
}
.sec-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:baseline;
  gap:18px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin-bottom:34px;
  padding-bottom:16px;
  border-bottom:2px solid var(--card-edge);
}
.sec-head h2{
  font-size:clamp(38px, 5.4vw, 60px);
  letter-spacing:-.02em;
}
.sec-head .tag{ margin-left:auto; }

.sec{ padding-block:clamp(58px, 7.4vw, 92px); }

/* Reveal — one orchestrated fade per section block */
.rv{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(16px); }
.rv.in{ opacity:1; transform:none; transition:opacity .62s ease, transform .62s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{ scroll-behavior:auto; }
  .rv{ opacity:1 !important; transform:none !important; transition:none !important; }
  *{ animation-duration:.001ms !important; transition-duration:.06s !important; }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   4. Hero
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.hero{
  position:relative;
  padding-top:clamp(52px, 8vw, 96px);
  padding-bottom:clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px);
  overflow:hidden;
}
/* faint horizon ruling — the planning grid */
.hero::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute; inset:0;
  background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(
    to bottom, transparent 0 63px, rgba(60,71,38,.07) 63px 64px);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero .shell{ position:relative; }

.hero-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.32fr) minmax(0,.86fr);
  gap:clamp(30px, 4.5vw, 66px);
  align-items:center;
}

.hero-loc{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:22px;
}
.hero-loc .dot{
  width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--olive);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(60,71,38,.16);
  flex:none;
}
.hero-loc span{ font-family:var(--data); font-size:13px; color:var(--olive); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.03em; }

.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(66px, 13.5vw, 168px);
  line-height:.84;
  letter-spacing:-.035em;
  margin-bottom:24px;
}
.hero h1 .ln{ display:block; }

.hero-role{
  font-family:var(--body);
  font-size:clamp(17px, 2vw, 21px);
  font-weight:700;
  line-height:1.4;
  color:var(--olive);
  max-width:42ch;
  margin-bottom:8px;
}
.hero-role-sub{
  font-size:16px;
  color:var(--mute);
  max-width:56ch;
  margin-bottom:26px;
}
.hero-lede{
  font-size:18px;
  color:var(--ink-soft);
  max-width:56ch;
  margin-bottom:32px;
}

/* Buttons */
.acts{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; align-items:center; }
.btn{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  padding:13px 22px;
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  font-weight:700;
  font-size:15.5px;
  text-decoration:none;
  border:2px solid var(--ink);
  transition:transform .16s ease, background-color .16s ease, color .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease;
}
.btn svg{ width:18px; height:18px; flex:none; }
.btn-solid{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--kraft); }
.btn-solid:hover{ background:var(--olive); border-color:var(--olive); transform:translateY(-2px); }
.btn-line{ background:transparent; color:var(--ink); }
.btn-line:hover{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--kraft); transform:translateY(-2px); }

/* Social */
.social{ display:flex; gap:10px; }
.social a{
  width:46px; height:46px;
  display:grid; place-items:center;
  border:2px solid var(--card-edge);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  background:var(--card);
  transition:border-color .16s ease, background-color .16s ease, color .16s ease, transform .16s ease;
}
.social a svg{ width:20px; height:20px; }
.social a:hover{ border-color:var(--olive); background:var(--olive); color:var(--card); transform:translateY(-2px); }

/* Portrait — notched kraft plate */
.portrait{
  position:relative;
  justify-self:end;
  width:100%;
  max-width:352px;
}
.portrait-plate{
  position:relative;
  border:2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  background:var(--card);
  padding:12px 12px 0;
  box-shadow:14px 14px 0 rgba(60,71,38,.17);
}
.portrait-plate img{
  width:100%;
  aspect-ratio:4/5;
  object-fit:cover;
  object-position:50% 22%;
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  background:var(--kraft-deep);
}
.portrait-ph{
  width:100%;
  aspect-ratio:4/5;
  border:2px dashed var(--card-edge);
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  display:grid; place-items:center;
  text-align:center;
  padding:20px;
  color:var(--mute);
  font-family:var(--data);
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.5;
}
.portrait-strip{
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px;
  padding:11px 2px 12px;
  font-family:var(--data);
  font-size:11.5px;
  letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:var(--mute);
}
.portrait-strip b{ color:var(--olive); font-weight:600; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   5. Outcomes band
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.band{
  background:var(--olive);
  color:var(--card);
  padding-block:clamp(38px, 5vw, 58px);
}
.band-note{
  font-family:var(--data);
  font-size:12px;
  letter-spacing:.06em;
  color:#CFD5BC;
  margin-bottom:26px;
}
.band-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:2px;
  background:rgba(243,238,226,.22);
  border-block:1px solid rgba(243,238,226,.22);
}
.band-cell{ background:var(--olive); padding:22px 20px 20px; }
.band-fig{
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(42px, 6vw, 66px);
  line-height:.9;
  letter-spacing:-.03em;
  color:#F3EEE2;
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:9px;
}
.band-lab{ font-size:14.5px; color:#DDE2CD; line-height:1.4; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   6. About
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.about-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,.9fr);
  gap:clamp(30px, 5vw, 62px);
  align-items:start;
}
.about-body p + p{ margin-top:19px; }
.about-body p{ font-size:18px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:62ch; }
.about-body .lead{
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-weight:700;
  font-size:clamp(25px, 3.1vw, 33px);
  line-height:1.16;
  color:var(--ink);
  letter-spacing:-.012em;
  margin-bottom:22px;
  max-width:24ch;
}

.focus{
  background:var(--card);
  border:2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  padding:26px 26px 22px;
}
.focus h3{
  font-size:26px;
  margin-bottom:4px;
}
.focus > .tag{ display:block; margin-bottom:20px; }
.focus li{
  display:flex; gap:13px;
  padding:13px 0;
  border-top:1px solid var(--card-edge);
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.48;
}
.focus li:first-of-type{ border-top:none; padding-top:4px; }
.focus li .k{
  font-family:var(--data);
  font-size:11.5px;
  color:var(--olive);
  font-weight:600;
  padding-top:4px;
  flex:none;
  width:26px;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   7. Capabilities
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.cap-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:230px minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:26px;
  padding:26px 0;
  border-top:1px solid var(--card-edge);
  align-items:start;
}
.cap-row:last-child{ border-bottom:1px solid var(--card-edge); }
.cap-name{
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-weight:700;
  font-size:26px;
  line-height:1.08;
  color:var(--ink);
}
.cap-count{
  display:block;
  font-family:var(--data);
  font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:600;
  color:var(--mute);
  letter-spacing:.05em;
  margin-top:7px;
}
.chips{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:9px; }
.chip{
  background:var(--card);
  border:1px solid var(--card-edge);
  border-radius:100px;
  padding:6px 15px;
  font-size:14.5px;
  font-weight:600;
  color:var(--ink-soft);
  transition:background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
}
.chip:hover{ background:var(--olive); border-color:var(--olive); color:var(--card); }
.chip.key{ background:var(--olive-tint); border-color:var(--olive-mid); color:var(--olive); }
.chip.key:hover{ background:var(--olive); color:var(--card); }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   8. Experience — the plan line
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.line{ position:relative; }
.line::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:50%; top:0; bottom:0;
  width:2px;
  margin-left:-1px;
  background:var(--card-edge);
}
.line-fill{
  position:absolute;
  left:50%; top:0;
  width:2px; margin-left:-1px;
  height:0;
  background:var(--olive);
  transition:height .12s linear;
}
.line-legend{
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  font-family:var(--data); font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.05em;
  color:var(--mute);
  margin-bottom:14px;
}

.job{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
  margin-bottom:46px;
}
.job:last-child{ margin-bottom:0; }
.job-card{
  background:var(--card);
  border:2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  padding:26px 28px 24px;
  position:relative;
}
/* left-side entry */
.job.l .job-card{ grid-column:1; margin-right:52px; }
/* right-side entry */
.job.r .job-card{ grid-column:2; margin-left:52px; }

/* connector stub + node on the line */
.job-card::after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  top:38px;
  width:38px; height:2px;
  background:var(--olive);
}
.job.l .job-card::after{ right:-40px; }
.job.r .job-card::after{ left:-40px; }

.job-node{
  position:absolute;
  top:31px; left:50%;
  width:17px; height:17px;
  margin-left:-8.5px;
  background:var(--kraft);
  border:3px solid var(--olive);
  border-radius:50%;
  z-index:2;
}
.job.latest .job-node{ background:var(--olive); }

.job-top{
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px 14px;
  align-items:baseline;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}
.job-co{
  font-family:var(--display);
  font-weight:800;
  font-size:31px;
  line-height:1.04;
  letter-spacing:-.018em;
}
.job-dates{
  font-family:var(--data);
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:600;
  color:var(--olive);
  background:var(--olive-tint);
  border-radius:100px;
  padding:4px 11px;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.job-role{
  font-size:16.5px;
  font-weight:700;
  color:var(--ink-soft);
  margin-bottom:17px;
}
.job ul{ display:grid; gap:12px; }
.job li{
  position:relative;
  padding-left:20px;
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.56;
  color:var(--ink-soft);
}
.job li::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:0; top:9px;
  width:8px; height:8px;
  border:2px solid var(--olive-mid);
  border-radius:1px;
}
.job-tech{
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:7px;
  margin-top:18px;
  padding-top:16px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--card-edge);
}
.job-tech span{
  font-family:var(--data);
  font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:600;
  color:var(--mute);
  border:1px solid var(--card-edge);
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  padding:3px 9px;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   9. Projects
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.proj-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:26px;
  align-items:start;
}
.proj{
  background:var(--card);
  border:2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  padding:30px 30px 26px;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
}
.proj-meta{
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:14px;
  margin-bottom:16px;
  font-family:var(--data); font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.05em;
  color:var(--mute); font-weight:600;
}
.proj-meta b{ color:var(--olive); font-weight:600; }
.proj h3{
  font-size:clamp(28px, 3.1vw, 35px);
  line-height:1.06;
  letter-spacing:-.02em;
  margin-bottom:16px;
}
.proj-prob{
  font-size:15.5px;
  color:var(--mute);
  border-left:3px solid var(--olive-mid);
  padding-left:14px;
  margin-bottom:18px;
  line-height:1.5;
}
.proj-desc{ font-size:16.5px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:22px; }

/* Delta readout — values taken verbatim from the résumé */
.delta{ margin-bottom:22px; }
.delta-cap{
  font-family:var(--data); font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.05em;
  color:var(--mute); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:12px;
}
.bar-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin-bottom:9px; }
.bar-key{
  font-family:var(--data); font-size:11.5px; color:var(--mute);
  width:46px; flex:none; font-weight:600;
}
.bar-track{ flex:1; height:16px; background:var(--kraft-deep); border-radius:var(--r-sm); overflow:hidden; }
.bar-fill{ height:100%; border-radius:var(--r-sm); width:0; transition:width .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1); }
.bar-fill.before{ background:var(--flag); }
.bar-fill.after{ background:var(--olive); }
.bar-val{
  font-family:var(--data); font-size:13px; font-weight:600;
  width:54px; flex:none; text-align:right; color:var(--ink);
}

.stat-tri{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:2px;
  background:var(--card-edge);
  border:1px solid var(--card-edge);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  overflow:hidden;
  margin-bottom:22px;
}
.stat-tri div{ background:var(--card); padding:14px 12px; }
.stat-tri strong{
  display:block;
  font-family:var(--display); font-weight:800;
  font-size:30px; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-.02em;
  color:var(--olive); margin-bottom:5px;
}
.stat-tri span{ font-size:13px; color:var(--mute); line-height:1.35; display:block; }

.proj-foot{
  margin-top:auto;
  padding-top:18px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--card-edge);
}
.proj-foot .chips{ margin-bottom:16px; }
.ghost{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px;
  font-family:var(--data); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600;
  color:var(--olive);
  text-decoration:none;
  border-bottom:2px solid var(--olive-mid);
  padding-bottom:2px;
  transition:color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
}
.ghost svg{ width:15px; height:15px; }
.ghost:hover{ color:var(--flag); border-color:var(--flag); }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   10. Education & certification
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.edu-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:26px;
}
.edu{
  border:2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  padding:30px;
  background:var(--card);
}
.edu.alt{ background:var(--olive); color:#F3EEE2; border-color:var(--olive); }
.edu .tag{ display:block; margin-bottom:16px; }
.edu.alt .tag{ color:#CFD5BC; }
.edu h3{ font-size:clamp(28px,3.2vw,37px); line-height:1.04; letter-spacing:-.02em; margin-bottom:10px; }
.edu-sub{ font-size:17px; color:var(--ink-soft); }
.edu.alt .edu-sub{ color:#E1E6D4; }
.edu-when{
  display:inline-block;
  margin-top:18px;
  font-family:var(--data); font-size:12px; font-weight:600;
  border-radius:100px; padding:5px 13px;
  background:var(--olive-tint); color:var(--olive);
}
.edu.alt .edu-when{ background:rgba(243,238,226,.16); color:#F3EEE2; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   11. Contact
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.contact{ background:var(--kraft-deep); }
.contact-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.05fr);
  gap:clamp(30px,5vw,58px);
  align-items:center;
}
.contact h2{
  font-size:clamp(44px, 6.6vw, 82px);
  line-height:.94;
  letter-spacing:-.028em;
  margin-bottom:18px;
}
.contact p{ font-size:18px; color:var(--ink-soft); max-width:42ch; margin-bottom:26px; }
.clist{ display:grid; gap:12px; }
.clist a, .clist div{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px;
  background:var(--card);
  border:2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);
  padding:15px 19px;
  text-decoration:none;
  transition:background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease, transform .15s ease;
}
.clist a:hover{ background:var(--olive); color:var(--card); transform:translateX(5px); }
.clist svg{ width:21px; height:21px; flex:none; }
.clist .lab{ font-family:var(--data); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--mute); display:block; margin-bottom:2px; font-weight:600; }
.clist a:hover .lab{ color:#CFD5BC; }
.clist .val{ font-size:16px; font-weight:600; word-break:break-word; }

footer{
  border-top:2px solid var(--card-edge);
  padding:26px 0;
  background:var(--kraft-deep);
}
.foot-in{
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px 22px;
  align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  font-family:var(--data); font-size:12px; color:var(--mute);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   12. Bottom dock navigation
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.dock{
  position:fixed;
  left:50%; bottom:16px;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  z-index:100;
  max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);
}
.dock-in{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px;
  background:var(--ink);
  border-radius:100px;
  padding:7px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(30,28,23,.3);
  overflow-x:auto;
  scrollbar-width:none;
}
.dock-in::-webkit-scrollbar{ display:none; }
.dock a{
  flex:none;
  padding:9px 17px;
  border-radius:100px;
  color:#C9C2AF;
  text-decoration:none;
  font-size:14.5px;
  font-weight:600;
  white-space:nowrap;
  transition:background-color .18s ease, color .18s ease;
}
.dock a:hover{ color:var(--card); background:rgba(243,238,226,.12); }
.dock a[aria-current="true"]{ background:var(--card); color:var(--ink); }
.dock .dock-cta{
  background:var(--olive); color:#F3EEE2;
  position:sticky; right:0; z-index:2;
  box-shadow:-14px 0 14px -6px var(--ink);
}
.dock .dock-cta:hover{ background:var(--olive-mid); color:#fff; }

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   13. Responsive
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (max-width:1080px){
  .hero-grid{ grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,.9fr); }
  .cap-row{ grid-template-columns:190px minmax(0,1fr); }
  .portrait{ max-width:330px; }
}

@media (max-width:900px){
  body{ font-size:16.5px; }
  .hero-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; align-items:start; }
  .portrait{ justify-self:start; max-width:300px; order:-1; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .portrait-plate{ box-shadow:10px 10px 0 rgba(60,71,38,.17); }
  .about-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .band-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
  .proj-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .edu-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .contact-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }

  /* plan line collapses to a single left rail */
  .line::before, .line-fill{ left:9px; margin-left:0; }
  .line-legend{ display:none; }
  .job{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .job.l .job-card, .job.r .job-card{ grid-column:1; margin:0 0 0 38px; }
  .job-card::after{ top:34px; width:24px; }
  .job.l .job-card::after, .job.r .job-card::after{ left:-26px; right:auto; }
  .job-node{ left:9px; margin-left:-8.5px; top:27px; }
}

@media (max-width:620px){
  :root{ --gut:18px; --dock-h:66px; }
  .portrait{ max-width:238px; }
  .hero h1{ letter-spacing:-.03em; }
  .cap-row{ grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:14px; padding:22px 0; }
  .cap-name{ font-size:22px; }
  .job-card{ padding:22px 20px 20px; }
  .job-co{ font-size:26px; }
  .proj{ padding:24px 21px 22px; }
  .focus{ padding:22px 20px 18px; }
  .edu{ padding:24px 21px; }
  .stat-tri{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .band-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .dock{ left:12px; right:12px; transform:none; max-width:none; }
  .dock a{ padding:9px 14px; font-size:14px; }
  .acts{ gap:10px; }
  .btn{ padding:12px 18px; font-size:15px; }
}

@media (max-width:360px){
  .hero h1{ font-size:54px; }
  .bar-key{ width:40px; }
  .bar-val{ width:48px; font-size:12px; }
  .social a{ width:42px; height:42px; }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   14. Print
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
@media print{
  .dock, .portrait-strip{ display:none; }
  body{ background:#fff; padding-bottom:0; }
  .rv{ opacity:1 !important; transform:none !important; }
  .job-card, .proj, .edu, .focus{ break-inside:avoid; }
}

<section class="sec" id="about">
  <div class="shell rv">
    <div class="sec-head">
      <h2>How I plan</h2>
      <p class="tag">about</p>
    </div>

    <div class="about-grid">
      <div class="about-body">
        <p class="lead">Planning only counts when the number changes a decision.</p>
        <p>I am a supply chain planning analyst with 4.5 years across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimization, S&amp;OP/IBP, new product introduction and ERP-driven planning environments. My work sits where the statistical forecast meets commercial reality and operational constraint — and the job is to reconcile the three into one plan everybody can commit to.</p>
        <p>That has meant owning SAP IBP demand planning for three business units, facilitating monthly S&amp;OP alignment, building DRP logic that surfaces capacity constraints weeks before they bite, and auditing the ERP master data and planning parameters that quietly distort net requirements when nobody is watching.</p>
        <p>Alongside the planning work I build the analytics that support it: SQL pipelines and Power BI dashboards that cut reporting cycle time, Python reconciliation that clears years of legacy data exceptions, and Excel scenario models that let leadership compare supply options before committing spend.</p>
      </div>

      <aside class="focus">
        <p class="tag">areas of focus</p>
        <h3>Where I go deep</h3>
        <ul>
          <li><span class="k">01</span><span>Statistical forecasting, forecast bias and variance, and root-cause analysis on the misses</span></li>
          <li><span class="k">02</span><span>Monthly S&amp;OP and IBP alignment across commercial, operational and finance inputs</span></li>
          <li><span class="k">03</span><span>Scenario planning and supply-risk quantification ahead of leadership decisions</span></li>
          <li><span class="k">04</span><span>ERP master data governance — MRP type, lot size, lead time, safety stock</span></li>
          <li><span class="k">05</span><span>NPI planning, DRP logic and end-to-end material availability through launch</span></li>
        </ul>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ==========================================================================
     BOTTOM DOCK NAVIGATION
     ========================================================================== -->
<nav class="dock" aria-label="Section navigation">
  <div class="dock-in">
    <a href="#about" data-spy>About</a>
    <a href="#skills" data-spy>Skills</a>
    <a href="#experience" data-spy>Experience</a>
    <a href="#projects" data-spy>Projects</a>
    <a href="#education" data-spy>Education</a>
    <a href="#contact" class="dock-cta">Contact</a>
  </div>
</nav>

<script>
/* ==========================================================================
   Harish Ramu — Supply Chain Planning Analyst
   Vanilla JS. Four small behaviours, no dependencies:
     1. Section reveal on scroll
     2. Bottom dock scroll-spy
     3. Plan-line progress fill through the experience timeline
     4. Delta bars animate to their résumé values when first seen
   ========================================================================== */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
     1. Reveal blocks as they enter the viewport
     --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.rv');

  if (reduced || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
    reveals.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('in'); });
  } else {
    var revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('in');
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.06 });

    reveals.forEach(function (el) { revealObserver.observe(el); });
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
     2. Bottom dock scroll-spy
     --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var dockLinks = Array.prototype.slice.call(
    document.querySelectorAll('.dock a[data-spy]')
  );
  var sections = dockLinks
    .map(function (link) { return document.querySelector(link.getAttribute('href')); })
    .filter(Boolean);

  function setActive(id) {
    dockLinks.forEach(function (link) {
      var match = link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id;
      if (match) {
        link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
      } else {
        link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
      }
    });
  }

  function spy() {
    var probe = window.scrollY + window.innerHeight * 0.34;
    var current = sections[0];
    sections.forEach(function (section) {
      if (section.offsetTop <= probe) { current = section; }
    });
    if (current) { setActive(current.id); }
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
     3. Plan-line progress fill
     --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var line = document.querySelector('.line');
  var lineFill = document.querySelector('.line-fill');

  function drawLine() {
    if (!line || !lineFill) { return; }
    var box = line.getBoundingClientRect();
    var marker = window.innerHeight * 0.55;
    var progress = (marker - box.top) / box.height;
    progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, progress));
    lineFill.style.height = (progress * 100) + '%';
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
     Shared scroll loop (rAF-throttled)
     --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var queued = false;
  function onScroll() {
    if (queued) { return; }
    queued = true;
    window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      spy();
      drawLine();
      queued = false;
    });
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll, { passive: true });
  onScroll();

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
     4. Delta bars — widths come from data-w, set from résumé figures only
     --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var bars = document.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill');

  function fillBars(scope) {
    scope.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill').forEach(function (bar) {
      bar.style.width = bar.getAttribute('data-w') + '%';
    });
  }

  if (reduced || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
    bars.forEach(function (bar) { bar.style.width = bar.getAttribute('data-w') + '%'; });
  } else {
    var barObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          fillBars(entry.target);
          barObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });

    document.querySelectorAll('.delta').forEach(function (block) {
      barObserver.observe(block);
    });
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
     5. Keep the dock out of the way of a focused element at the page foot
     --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { document.activeElement && document.activeElement.blur(); }
  });

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
     6. Copy the year into the footer so it never goes stale
     --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  var yearSlot = document.getElementById('year');
  if (yearSlot) { yearSlot.textContent = new Date().getFullYear(); }
})();

</script>
